business_summary: IRIDEX Corporation, an ophthalmic medical technology company, provides therapeutic based laser systems, delivery devices, and consumable instrumentation to treat sight-threatening eye diseases in ophthalmology. It offers laser consoles, such as Cyclo G6 laser system for use in the treatment of glaucoma; IQ 532 and IQ 577 laser systems, which are used for the treatment of retinal disorders; and OcuLight TX, OcuLight SL, OcuLight SLx, OcuLight GL, and OcuLight GLx laser photocoagulation systems that are used to treat proliferative diabetic retinopathy, macular holes, retinal tears, and detachments. The company also provides delivery devices, including slit lamp adapter, which allows the physician to utilize a standard slit lamp in diagnosis and treatment procedures; TxCell scanning laser delivery system that allows the physician to perform multi-spot pattern scanning; and laser indirect ophthalmoscope for use in procedures to treat peripheral retinal disorders. In addition, it offers MicroPulse P3 Probe, which is used with its Cylco G6 laser system to perform transscleral laser therapy; G-Probe and G-Probe Illuminate, which are used in procedures to treat uncontrolled and refractory glaucoma; and EndoProbe family of products that are used for endophotocoagulation. The company serves ophthalmologists, research and teaching hospitals, government installations, surgical centers, hospitals, veterinary practices, and office clinics through direct and independent sales force in the United States, as well as through independent distributors internationally. It operates in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia/Pacific region, and the Americas. The company was formerly known as IRIS Medical Instruments, Inc. and changed its name to IRIDEX Corporation in November 1995. IRIDEX Corporation was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
business_summary_ko: 안과 의료 기술 회사인 IRIDEX Corporation은 안과 분야에서 시력을 위협하는 안과 질환을 치료하기 위한 치료 기반 레이저 시스템, 전달 장치 및 소모품 장비를 제공합니다. 녹내장 치료에 사용되는 Cyclo G6 레이저 시스템과 같은 레이저 콘솔을 제공합니다. 망막 장애 치료에 사용되는 IQ 532 및 IQ 577 레이저 시스템; 증식성 당뇨병성 망막병증, 황반원공, 망막 열공 및 박리를 치료하는 데 사용되는 OcuLight TX, OcuLight SL, OcuLight SLx, OcuLight GL 및 OcuLight GLx 레이저 광응고 시스템. 이 회사는 또한 의사가 진단 및 치료 과정에서 표준 세극등을 활용할 수 있도록 하는 세극등 어댑터를 포함한 전달 장치를 제공합니다. 의사가 다중 스팟 패턴 스캐닝을 수행할 수 있게 해주는 TxCell 스캐닝 레이저 전달 시스템; 말초 망막 장애 치료 절차에 사용하기 위한 레이저 간접 검안경. 또한 경공막 레이저 치료를 수행하기 위해 Cylco G6 레이저 시스템과 함께 사용되는 MicroPulse P3 프로브도 제공합니다. 통제되지 않은 불응성 질환을 치료하는 절차에 사용되는 G-프로브 및 G-프로브 일루미네이트
